name: The Edinburgh Grand
positioning: The Edinburgh Grand, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Edinburgh: a former bank headquarters on St Andrew Square in the New Town, with residential-style suites that have their own kitchens and a three-bedroom Penthouse with a rooftop terrace
best_for: Travelers who want a central New Town base steps from the Royal Mile and Princes Street
Families and longer stays wanting suites with kitchens and living space
History lovers drawn to a former bank headquarters with its vaults still in place

facts.text: The hotel sits on St Andrew Square in Edinburgh's New Town.
The hotel is steps from the Royal Mile and Princes Street.
The hotel is set within the former headquarters of one of Scotland's most prestigious banks.
The former bank vault is now home to the hotel's gym.
The original bank burner vault is still preserved within one of the suites.
Every suite has a fully equipped kitchen, a dedicated dining area and a living space.
The three-bedroom Penthouse has a rooftop terrace with 360-degree views across Edinburgh.
The spa offers expert facials and restorative body massage.
Each evening guests are invited to a dram of locally selected Scotch whisky paired with chocolate.
A weekly hotel heritage tour is followed by a taste of cranachan.
Hawksmoor is set within the former Banking Hall and is known for dry-aged steaks and Scottish seafood.
Afternoon Tea is served at The Register Club, high above St Andrew Square, with a distinctly Scottish character.

highlights.text: The hotel is set within the former headquarters of one of Scotland's most prestigious banks, and the former bank vault is now the gym.
The three-bedroom Penthouse has a rooftop terrace with 360-degree views across Edinburgh.
Each evening guests are invited to a dram of locally selected Scotch whisky paired with chocolate.
Every suite has a fully equipped kitchen, a dedicated dining area and a living space.

considerations.text: The spa focuses on treatments and has no pools or thermal experiences.
Parking is off-site, at the nearby St James Quarter Car Park.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
